newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cimpor seeks Spanish cement firm - paper.
newsitem.headline: Cimpor seeks Spanish cement firm - paper.

text.p: Portuguese cement group Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal is interested in acquiring a Spanish cement manufacturer, Diario de Noticias newspaper reported.
Sources in the sector told the paper in a report from Madrid that Cimpor may be interested in acquiring a Spanish cement manufacturer located near the border with Portugal.
The paper said talks with French company Ciments Francais over the possibility of acquiring its cement factory in Malaga had ended without results.
Cimpor announced last week that it had bought two Brazilian cement businesses for 62 billion escudos ($394 million).
Cimpor already owns Spanish cement firm Corporacion Noroeste.
